channel.title: Ghost in the Patch
channel.description: Synth animism. Live-patching, learning, and listening for ghosts in the machine.

item.title: Halloween Voices and Digital Sea
item.description: A Ghost in the Patch live set for a fall festival and Halloween party: MicroFreak speech patches give way to swelling pads, unstable tones and filtered noise, with phrases captured and returned as overlapping audio loops.
item.itunes:author: Codekiln
item.itunes:summary: A Ghost in the Patch live set for a fall festival and Halloween party: MicroFreak speech patches give way to swelling pads, unstable tones and filtered noise, with phrases captured and returned as overlapping audio loops.

item.title: NoiseBusters, Fight and TaBass
item.description: A Ghost in the Patch session with three MicroFreak factory presets in layered takes: NoiseBusters opens as a hall of mirrors, Fight comes in as a lead with pad pressure, and TaBass enters near the end as a little thumper, with cycling-envelope and filter sweeps throughout.

item.title: The Unstable over USB
item.description: A Ghost in the Patch session recorded at the library with MicroFreak preset 151 The Unstable, a slow Launchpad sequence and USB-only MIDI: Ableton Live sends the clock, Launchpad pad pressure drives the pad, and nothing needed a MIDI panic.

item.title: Voidom and MIDI clock
item.description: A Ghost in the Patch session with MicroFreak preset 016 Voidom: tracing MIDI connections and clock problems between the Launchpad Pro, MicroFreak and Ableton Live, then combining Launchpad sequencing with recorded Session clips.

item.title: Eonz between two sequencers
item.description: A Ghost in the Patch session with MicroFreak preset 77 Eonz and the Launchpad Pro: two-way MIDI, competing clocks, shared filter pulses and recording one sequencer into the other.

item.description: A Ghost in the Patch session exploring MicroFreak preset 174 Auster with the Launchpad Pro sequencer: touch articulation, two-way MIDI, clock sync, scale modes and layered patterns.

item.title: GitP.26.10.11
item.description: A slow MicroFreak improvisation that moves from harmonic tones into a blurred, pitch-bent drone and closes with a virtual analog sound. Recorded in Ableton Live without spoken commentary.

item.title: GitP.26.10.07
item.description: A MicroFreak improvisation recorded in Ableton Live at 109 BPM. Its sections run from a toccata and a 90's air tune through a Casio-style passage and a sequence to a closing descan-sigh.

item.title: GitP.26.10.06 — Chords, Formants, and Sequencers
item.description: A MicroFreak improvisation starting from an initialized patch: chord oscillators, cycling-envelope and LFO modulation, and a turn toward formant sounds. Shimmering textures give way to a gruff emergence, a ballpark organ, and a trippy denouement, with the Launchpad sequencer and MicroFreak arpeggiator along the way.
